name: Rider Nameplates
description: Floating screen-space nameplates above all riders (ego + bots), fully customizable in the cog menu.

settings.label: Name format
settings.description: full = First Last · short = first name · last = last name · none = no name (stats only)

settings.label: Plate color mode
settings.description: custom = fixed colors below · random = stable per rider · helmet = each rider's helmet color

settings.label: Push overlapping plates up
settings.description: Plates that would overlap move out of each other's way (nearest rider keeps its spot)

settings.label: Fan out sideways when bunched
settings.description: Also slides plates left/right and keeps them clear of every rider's avatar. Off = move up only

settings.label: Context-aware plates
settings.description: In a crowd, calm riders' plates fade and only surging riders (attack/sprint) stand out

settings.label: Crowd threshold (riders)
settings.description: Fading starts when MORE than this many plates are on screen

settings.label: Calm riders' opacity in a crowd (%)
Surge baseline window (s)
settings.description: Power/cadence are compared against the rider's own average over roughly this long (5 – 120)

settings.label: Sustain before confirming (s)
settings.description: A kick must hold this long to count as an attack/sprint (1 – 15)

settings.label: Leader lines to riders
settings.description: Thin line from a displaced plate back to its rider
